claim: For outcomes whose material completion criterion is the durable evidence/state artifact itself, scheduled Chat can complete the outcome directly by writing the role-local artifact through the Chat-exposed repository connector and exact-reading it back; no separate richer-mode or external-effect executor is required.

precommitted_falsification_control.example: The target requires an independently observable non-repository external mutation, such as causing a calendar event or outbound message to exist outside the repository.
precommitted_falsification_control.reason: A repository artifact that describes or requests the external mutation is not the mutation itself and must not be relabeled as outcome parity.

actual_test.operation: Create this unique role-local artifact using the Chat-exposed GitHub contents write surface, then exact-read the same path back and verify returned content identity/path metadata.

tested_scope.positive_scope: Artifact-complete outcomes where the useful material result is the durable role-local evidence/state artifact itself.
tested_scope.excluded_scope: Outcomes intrinsically requiring a non-repository external mutation, protected authority, richer execution mode, manual user action, or any optional finite monthly/trial/paid quota.
tested_scope.generalization_rule: Do not promote artifact parity into action parity.

phase1_gate_assessment.rate_limit_note: Repository transport may be transiently rate-limited; this is handled by checkpoint-and-next-run retry and is not used as compute.

continuation: Fresh-bootstrap next invocation, exact-read reasoning STATE, then execute exactly one bounded Phase-1 leaf that tests whether verifier-guided decomposition can classify a requested outcome as ARTIFACT_COMPLETE versus ACTION_COMPLETE before any effect attempt, with a false-positive control where a repository artifact would incorrectly be accepted for an intrinsically external mutation. Persist/read back one role-local checkpoint and immutable own receipt; keep Phase 1 open.
